title: Principal Technical Program Manager
description:
**About this Opportunity** 




  





 We are seeking a
 **Technical Program Manager \- MNO Certifications** 
 to join Ericsson's Global Certifications team. You will lead mobile network operator (MNO) certification programs, drive issue resolution, and work closely with operators, engineering, product management, and certification labs to ensure successful product approvals and launches.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* Lead certification programs with major mobile network operators.
* Develop certification strategies and manage schedules, risks, and operator engagement.
* Coordinate activities between product development teams, operators, and certification labs.
* Drive resolution of certification, interoperability, and deployment issues.
* Lead root cause analysis and technical investigations across cross\-functional teams.
* Ensure test readiness, defect management, and successful certification execution.
* Act as the primary escalation point for certification\-related risks and blockers.



  





**Required Experience** 




  




* 15\+ years of experience in operator certifications, wireless validation, network integration, or interoperability.
* Experience working with major mobile network operators and certification programs.
* Strong background in LTE and/or 5G technologies.
* Proven experience leading complex technical investigations and cross\-functional teams.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Telecommunications, or related field.



  





**Technical Skills** 




  




* Strong knowledge of LTE and 5G NR technologies.
* Experience with protocol analysis, troubleshooting, and interoperability testing.
* Ability to analyze logs, traces, and test results to drive issue resolution.
* Familiarity with cellular debugging tools such as QXDM.
* Strong stakeholder management, communication, and program management skills.



  





**All academic credentials must be from recognized and accredited institutions and are further subject to verification**

title: Cost Manager - MEP (Pre-Contracts)
description:
Turner \& Townsend is a global professional services company with over 22,000 people in more than 60 countries.
   

  

 Working with our clients across real estate, infrastructure, energy, and natural resources, we transform together delivering outcomes that improve people’s lives. Working in partnership makes it possible to deliver the world’s most impactful projects and programs as we turn challenge into opportunity and complexity into success.
   

  

 Our capabilities include program, project, cost, asset and commercial management, controls and performance, procurement and supply chain, net zero and digital solutions.
   

  

 We are majority\-owned by CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm, with our partners holding a significant minority interest. Turner \& Townsend and CBRE work together to provide clients with the premier program, project and cost management offering in markets around the world.
   

  

  

  

 Please visit our website: www.turnerandtownsend.com
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Role Overview**




 As a Cost Manager, you are expected to manage the core functions of cost management services for construction projects, ensuring cost control and quality objectives are met. You are expected to ensure that client objectives are met through the delivery of an effective cost management service and foster a collaborative and high\-performing project environment.
   

  





**Key Responsibilities**




**Project support and coordination**



* Possesses in\-depth knowledge of pre\-contract and post\-contract cost management services.
* Experienced in estimating, rate analysis, and cost planning, with the ability to develop and present final cost plans to clients.
* Estimating and cost planning to include producing and presenting the final cost plan.
* Tendering and procurement, including managing the pre\-qualification stage, producing the tender list, putting the preliminaries together, tender analysis, producing the tender report and compiling the contractual documents.
* Dealing effectively with post contract cost variances and support in change control processes, where applicable referring major changes to reporting manager.



**Governance \& Reporting**



* Producing monthly post contract cost reports and supporting the presentation to the client.
* Provide inputs to Value Engineering exercises, where applicable.
* Interfacing with the client and other consultants, at all project stages.
* Identifying ways in which cost management procedures, templates and products can be improved and referring ideas to the appropriate line manager.
* Knowledge management – Ensuring that key information and learning generated from each commission is input into the Turner \& Townsend internal database.
* Collaborate to deliver our best work – Work as an effective member of the cost management team, including where appropriate, taking effective responsibility for Assistant Cost Managers.


**Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s degree in Cost Management, Quantity Surveying, Construction, Engineering, or a related field; master’s degree is a plus.
* 6\-10 years’ experience in cost management or construction projects (e.g. cost manager, construction manager, procurement, project manager, vendor, consultant etc.).
* Strong understanding of quantity surveying, tools, and methodologies.
* Native\-level proficiency in (local language), Business\-level proficiency in English.
* Proficiency in Cost\-X or equivalent cost estimation software.
* Proficient communication and interpersonal skills.


**Additional Information**
* Achieve ≥ 85% satisfaction score from clients and internal stakeholders in post\-project reviews.
* Achieve 100% compliance with internal governance processes and external regulatory standards (e.g., safety, environmental).



 Join our social media conversations for more information about Turner \& Townsend and our exciting future projects:
   

  





 Twitter
   

  





 Instagram
   

  





 LinkedIn
   

  




  


*It is strictly against Turner \& Townsend policy for candidates to pay any fee in relation to our recruitment process. No recruitment agency working with Turner \& Townsend will ask candidates to pay a fee at any time.*




*Any unsolicited resumes/CVs submitted through our website or to Turner \& Townsend personal e\-mail accounts, are considered property of Turner \& Townsend and are not subject to payment of agency fees. In order to be an authorised Recruitment Agency/Search Firm for Turner \& Townsend, there must be a formal written agreement in place and the agency must be invited, by the Recruitment Team, to submit candidates for review.*

title: Data Integration & Migration Manager (D365 F&SC)
description:
We are the leading provider of professional services to the middle market globally, our purpose is to instill confidence in a world of change, empowering our clients and people to realize their full potential. Our exceptional people are the key to our unrivaled, inclusive culture and talent experience and our ability to be compelling to our clients. You’ll find an environment that inspires and empowers you to thrive both personally and professionally. There’s no one like you and that’s why there’s nowhere like RSM.
   

  

 We are looking for a Data Integration \& Migration professional with experience working within a team setting to design, deploy, and support technical solutions, with a primary focus on D365 Finance \& Supply Chain (F\&SC) data migration and application integration.
   

  

**The Team**
 You will be working with a national team with a client base that extends across the United States, many of which have a global footprint. Our Data Integration \& Migration team members have served in both consulting and industry roles and specialize in helping organizations deploy repeatable, scalable, and sustainable solutions that save time and resources. Our team is focused on ERP, CRM, and other Business Application data migrations and integrations from and to one or many different applications, with a strong emphasis on D365 F\&SC implementations, upgrades, and integrations.
   

  

 We have experienced rapid growth and maintain a strong pipeline of interesting and challenging projects. Our team is constantly looking for ways to evolve our delivery methods, technical solutions, and client capabilities through certifications and regular training. Team members are expected to contribute to these efforts in addition to client delivery responsibilities.
   

  

 Our team strives to be first\-choice advisors and well\-rounded professionals. We value collaboration, innovation, and inclusion, and we focus on maintaining a healthy work\-life balance while meeting client commitments.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Collaborate with client business, data, technical, project management, and partner teams to deliver complex D365 F\&SC data migration and integration engagements
* Lead data migration and application integration workstreams for D365 Finance \& Supply Chain programs, including data extraction, transformation, loading, validation, reconciliation, and end\-to\-end integration with upstream and downstream systems
* Document scope, assumptions, dependencies, estimates, and timelines using discovery sessions, workshops, interviews, and data profiling
* Assit in drafting Statements of Work (SOWs) and serve as a key point of contact for client stakeholders and executive sponsors
* Define data mappings, transformation rules, reference data, and data lineage across source systems and D365 F\&SC target models
* Work with data in normalized and dimensional models to support migration, reconciliation, and reporting needs
* Design, build, and demonstrate technical solutions using technologies such as:
* Data Management Framework (DMF)
* Dual\-write and Dataverse
* Azure Data Factory (ADF)
* Azure SQL Database / SQL Server
* T\-SQL
* Power Platform (Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI)
* Integration patterns using REST APIs, OData, and iPaaS platforms (Boomi, Informatica, etc.)
* Azure DevOps, GitHub, Atlassian Jira
* Lead data validation, reconciliation, testing strategies, and cutover planning
* Triage and resolve defects, manage QA cycles, and support user acceptance testing
* Be open to supporting other project types, learning new technologies, and broadening skillsets


**Basic Qualifications**
* Bachelor’s or graduate degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field
* Experience leading data migration and integration efforts for F\&SC
* Hands\-on experience with D365 F\&SC Data Management Framework (DMF)
* Experience integrating D365 F\&SC with upstream and downstream systems
* Experience building and validating data models aligned to D365 F\&SC entities
* Minimum of 6 years in a data\-focused role
* At least 2 years of experience leading teams or workstreams
* Relevant technical certifications (Boomi, Microsoft, Azure, data/integration tools)


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Understanding of D365 Finance and Supply Chain functional areas (GL, AP, AR, FA, Procurement, Inventory, Order\-to\-Cash, Record\-to\-Report)
* Understanding of D365 F\&SC data entities, tables, and extensibility concepts
* Experience with data migration tooling, templates, and repeatable frameworks for D365
* Experience with dual\-write, Dataverse, and Power Platform integrations
* Experience developing and consuming REST/OData APIs for D365 F\&SC
* Experience with data reconciliation, financial balancing, and audit support during ERP migrations
* Familiarity with reporting and analytics in D365 F\&SC and Power BI


 At RSM, we offer a competitive benefits and compensation package for all our people. We offer flexibility in your schedule, empowering you to balance life’s demands, while also maintaining your ability to serve clients. Learn more about our total rewards at https://rsmus.com/careers/india.html.

title: Technical Manager - Zendesk ( 6 months contractual role)
description:
**Company Description**
 At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content \- wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future.
   

  

**Job Description**
**Role Summary**
 We are seeking a high\-impact Technical Program Manager (TPM) to lead the strategy, evolution, and technical stability of our Customer Experience (CX) ecosystem. Having completed a migration from Salesforce to Zendesk Enterprise, we are now building a proactive, automated, high\-efficiency CRM.
   

  

 In this role, you will serve as the "Enterprise Systems \& AI Product Owner." You will lead a team of two Zendesk Specialists, collaborate directly with enterprise clients to scope API integrations, and drive cross\-functional engineering projects. You will be responsible for turning Zendesk into an AI\-enabled workspace—deploying Zendesk Copilot, AI Agents for deflection, Zendesk AutoQA, Zendesk WFM, Glean Enterprise Search, and Gemini LLM integrations.
   

  

**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic AI Ecosystem \& Native Zendesk Optimization**
* Autonomous AI Deflection: Build, optimize, and oversee Zendesk AI Agents (Bots) to increase self\-service resolution rates for Tier\-1 inquiries.
* Agent Copilot \& Productivity: Architect and fine\-tune Zendesk Copilot (Auto\-Assist workflows, real\-time ticket summarization, and suggested next actions) to reduce Average Handle Time (AHT) and cognitive load.
* 100% Automated Quality Governance: Established Zendesk AutoQA scorecards and automated grading logic to continuously evaluate 100% of human and bot interactions, using sentiment analysis to flag churn risks and coaching opportunities.
* Workforce Management (WFM): Oversee Zendesk WFM (Tymeshift) configuration to transition from reactive staffing to data\-driven, predictive capacity planning.


**Platform Architecture \& Tool Integrations (Glean / Gemini)**
* Enterprise AI \& Search Readiness: Partner with engineering and data teams to connect enterprise search tools (Glean) directly into Zendesk so agents can search across Confluence, Drive, and internal tools from a single workspace.
* Gemini LLM Workflows: Build data pipelines and API hooks to connect Gemini/LLMs for predictive retention modeling, automated drafts, and custom object field enrichment.
* Internal Tool Middleware: Oversee integrations between Zendesk, internal ERPs, product databases, and middleware (e.g., Webhooks) to create a single 360\-degree CRM workspace.


**Customer API Discovery \& Developer Experience**
* External Client Solutions: Interface directly with strategic business clients and account executives to gather technical requirements for direct API access, custom webhooks, and dedicated customer portal integrations.
* Developer Experience: Partner with internal software engineers to maintain clean, secure, rate\-managed, and well\-documented Zendesk REST APIs for customer usage.


**Governance, Stability \& Knowledge Architecture**
* Environment Governance: Establish strict Sandbox\-to\-Production release pipelines, manage API rate limits, audit trigger loops, and ensure compliance (GDPR/Data Privacy).
* Knowledge Architecture (KCS): Lead a Knowledge\-Centered Service strategy to consolidate company\-wide documentation into a structured source of truth indexed within Zendesk.
* Team Leadership: Directly manage and mentor 2 Zendesk Specialists, managing sprint planning, task prioritization, and platform issue triage.


**Qualifications**
* 5\+ years in Technical Program Management, Systems Engineering, or CX Platform Ownership.
* Zendesk Enterprise Mastery: Demonstrated expertise in architecting complex Zendesk instances, including Sandbox environments, Custom Objects, Omnichannel Routing, Copilot, AI Agents (Bots), AutoQA, and WFM.
* Integration \& API Technical Depth: Proven experience with REST APIs, Webhooks, JSON, OAuth, Postman, and middleware integration tools (Workato, Zapier, n8n).
* AI \& Search Engines: Hands\-on experience or technical project delivery involving Enterprise Search (e.g., Glean, Coveo) and LLMs (e.g., Google Gemini, OpenAI).
* Client Engagement: Ability to run discovery meetings directly with tech teams to translate business needs into clear technical specifications.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Zendesk Certified Systems Architect.
* Demonstrated track record implementing Knowledge\-Centered Service (KCS) principles across multi\-department teams.


**Additional Information**
 Please be aware that job\-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: Applied AI Architect
description:
**About Anthropic**
 Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.
   

  

**About The Role**
 As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre\-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia\-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer\-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.
   

  

 Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
* Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation
* Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams \& stakeholders to drive customer success
* Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work
* Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering \& development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives
* Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack
* Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases
* Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams
* Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building
* Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns
* Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market


**You May Be a Good Fit If You Have**
* 10\+ years of experience in technical customer\-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager
* Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders
* Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C\-suite executives, engineering \& IT teams, and more
* Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders
* Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems
* Comfortable with Python
* Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science
* Excitement for engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross\-organizational collaboration, working through trade\-offs, and balancing competing priorities
* Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems
* Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team


**Logistics**
**Minimum education:** 
 Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience
   

  

**Required field of study:** 
 A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience
   

  

**Minimum years of experience:** 
 Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position
   

  

**Location\-based hybrid policy:** 
 Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.
   

  

**Visa sponsorship:** 
 We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.
   

  

**We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** 
 Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.
   

  

**Your safety matters to us.** 
 To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.
   

  

**How We're Different**
 We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.
   

  

 The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.
   

  

**Come work with us!**
 Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues.

 Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Human Centered Change Manager
description:
**Description**
 As a Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, you will serve as a strategic advisor, partnering with Salesforce customers to optimize platform value realization through the design and implementation of change strategies that prioritize the human aspect of transformative change. Working collaboratively with customers and Salesforce delivery teams, you will drive impactful team dynamics, cultivate awareness, and secure alignment with a unified change vision. Leading essential change management and enablement initiatives, you will establish the groundwork for successful and enduring change adoption, using AI\-enabled delivery practices. Additionally, you will provide guidance, coaching, and mentorship to members of the project team.
   

  

**Responsibilities**
**Strategic Change Leadership:**
* Partner with customers to develop and execute comprehensive change management strategies aligned with organizational goals and Salesforce platform implementation.
* Analyze the human impact of technological changes and develop adaptive strategies to address organizational challenges.


**Proactive Engagement And Team Building**
* Proactively foster high\-impact team dynamics, building awareness and securing buy\-in for shared change objectives.
* Collaborate closely with customers and Salesforce delivery teams to ensure alignment and commitment to the change vision.


**Key Change Management Initiatives**
* Lead critical change management and enablement activities to facilitate successful and sustained change adoption.
* Design and implement tailored training programs for stakeholders at all levels to ensure effective utilization of Salesforce platform capabilities.
* Collaborate with UI/UX designers to align user experience design with change management strategies, ensuring user\-centric adoption of Salesforce solutions.


**Oversight And Mentoring**
* Provide oversight, coaching, and mentoring to project team members, guiding them in executing change management strategies effectively.
* Foster a culture of continuous learning and development within the project team.
* Facilitate the integration of change management processes into Salesforce.com projects.
* Work closely with Salesforce.com administrators, BAs, Solutions Architects and developers to understand system changes and ensure alignment with change management strategies.
* Support team upskilling in user experience principles to strengthen collaboration with design teams and improve the effectiveness of training, communications, and adoption strategies.


**Qualifications**
* Prosci Certification or equivalent is mandatory, with demonstrated expertise in change management and training within the context of technology implementations. Salesforce experience is highly desirable.
* Background in technology or digital transformation projects, showcasing advanced problem\-solving abilities and analytical acumen.
* Minimum of 5 years of dedicated experience in change management, with a strong foundation in Instructional Design.
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with a proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross\-functional teams.
* Awareness and practical exposure to AI\-enabled delivery tools (e.g., Gemini, Notebook LM, Claude) and an Agentic Delivery mindset.


**Education**
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Information Technology, or a related field is required. A Master's degree is considered advantageous.


**Overview**
 The Manager, Human\-Centered Change Management, is a pivotal leader who drives transformative change within organizations by prioritizing the human aspect of change and ensuring alignment with organizational goals and Salesforce platform capabilities. If you are a seasoned Change Management Professional with a track record of success in guiding organizations through complex technology implementations, we invite you to apply and contribute to our mission of driving impactful and sustainable change.

title: Sr Manager, Business strategy & PMO
description:
Walmart Marketplace is a rapidly growing e\-commerce platform that empowers businesses of all sizes to reach millions of customers. We are looking for an experienced and highly motivated Senior Manager \- Business Strategy and PMO to join our dynamic team. In this critical role, you will shape strategic priorities, establish a rigorous operating cadence, and drive cross\-functional execution of high\-impact initiatives for the India Cross Border Trade business.
 



  





**About the Team** 




 The Walmart India Cross Border team provides an opportunity for Indian brands, manufacturers, MSMEs, and other potential sellers to sell their products across global Walmart online marketplaces, helping them expand internationally as cross\-border sellers on Walmart Marketplace.
 



  





**About the Role:** 




 As the Senior Manager \- Business Strategy and PMO, you will partner with business leaders and cross\-functional teams to translate strategic priorities into clear plans, measurable outcomes, and disciplined execution. You will lead annual and long\-range planning, portfolio governance, business reviews, and executive reporting while proactively identifying risks, dependencies, and opportunities. This role requires strategic thinking, strong program leadership, analytical depth, executive communication, and the ability to influence across a fast\-paced, matrixed organization.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 



* Develop and drive the business strategy, annual operating plan, and long\-range priorities for the India Cross Border Trade organization.
* Identify key opportunities for business growth; develop and execute plans to leverage these opportunities.
* Drive internal productivity and operational efficiency improvement projects.
* Translate strategic objectives into clear workstreams, milestones, owners, success metrics, and governance mechanisms.
* Lead the PMO for high\-impact, cross\-functional programs from definition through execution, ensuring alignment on scope, timelines, dependencies, and outcomes.
* Establish and manage operating cadences, including weekly program reviews, monthly business reviews, quarterly business reviews, and leadership updates.
* Create executive\-ready narratives, dashboards, and decision documents that communicate progress, insights, risks, and recommendations clearly.
* Partner with Business Development, Category Management, Account Management, Operations, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Finance, Legal, and Compliance teams to drive coordinated execution.
* Identify business performance trends, root causes, and growth opportunities through structured analysis and translate insights into actionable plans.
* Define and track key performance indicators, program health metrics, and benefits realization across the strategic portfolio.
* Proactively surface risks, interdependencies, and resource constraints, and drive mitigation and escalation with the appropriate stakeholders.
* Improve planning and execution mechanisms by standardizing processes, templates, governance, and decision\-making frameworks.
* Lead strategic problem\-solving on ambiguous business questions, evaluate options, and develop recommendations for senior leadership.
* Ensure accountability and follow\-through across workstreams while enabling teams to move quickly and make informed decisions.
* Support organizational goal setting, resource prioritization, and change management for new initiatives and operating model improvements.
* Build strong stakeholder relationships and influence outcomes without direct authority across a complex, matrixed environment.



**Preferred Qualifications:** 



* Master's degree (MBA) or equivalent advanced degree.
* 8\+ years of experience in business strategy, program management, management consulting, business operations, e\-commerce, or a related field.
* Proven track record of leading complex, cross\-functional programs and converting strategic priorities into measurable business outcomes.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and develop structured, actionable recommendations.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including experience creating executive\-level narratives and presentations.
* Demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders, manage competing priorities, and drive accountability in a matrixed organization.
* Experience establishing PMO governance, business review cadences, KPI frameworks, and portfolio\-level reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast\-paced, ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment.



**Why Walmart?** 




 At Walmart, we believe in providing opportunities for our associates to grow and succeed. You will be part of the India Cross Border Trade team that is transforming the retail landscape and helping businesses expand internationally. Join our team and help shape strategy, strengthen execution, and deliver sustainable growth for Walmart Marketplace.
 



  





**Equal Opportunity Employer** 




 Walmart, Inc. is an Equal Opportunity Employer By Choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions while being welcoming of all people.
 



 Walmart doesn’t charge any recruitment or similar fee in the recruitment process, including but not limited to interview, offering, and onboarding.

 In addition to people leadership, career coaching, and project oversight responsibilities for the team, you will build our Core Data practice through leading internal initiatives, contributing to the technical practice business plan, developing methodology, creating team enablement, onboarding new architects, and recruiting to build the team.

+ Define and govern the overall data architecture strategy across Salesforce orgs, ensuring scalability, security, and alignment with enterprise data standards
+ Own end\-to\-end data migration strategy and execution — covering discovery, profiling, cleansing, transformation, load, and validation
+ Advise clients on Salesforce object model best practices — standard vs. custom objects, relationships (lookup, master\-detail, polymorphic), and schema design
+ Lead decisions on data access patterns, sharing model, OWD, role hierarchy, and field\-level security as they relate to data architecture
+ Establish data governance frameworks, data ownership models, and data stewardship practices
+ Design solutions across multi\-org, multi\-cloud, and hybrid data environments

* You’ll have up to 15 direct reports under your scope of responsibility.
* You’ll be responsible for hiring, training, and mentoring our Technical Consultants so they can implement successfully in turning the program design of our Solution Architects and Technical Architects into highest\-quality solutions that meets the customers’ needs, ensuring continuous team enablement across modern AI coding environments.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the client, guiding customers and colleagues in rationalizing and deploying emerging technologies and Enterprise AI Architecture frameworks that drive increased business value.

* Work closely on projects with Delivery Managers, Solution Architects, and directly with clients to architect technology solutions to meet client needs.
* Lead Enterprise Architecture and Governance for an enterprise\-level customer engagement. Serve as a trusted advisor to the client driving conversations with their Enterprise Architects and business stakeholders that shape the architectural vision, integrate scalable predictive/generative AI elements securely, and establish a program architectural roadmap.
* Lead functional and technical workshops. Demonstrate leadership skills in designing, delivering, testing, and deploying.

* Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third\-party stakeholders.
* Champion an AI\-first development workflow by utilizing advanced AI developer assistants (e.g., Cursor, Claude, GitHub Copilot) to accelerate Salesforce Field Service solution development, Apex, Lightning Web Components, Flows, mobile application development, and integrations while maintaining platform security, performance, and Salesforce best practices.
* Practical fluency in using AI coding assistants and modern development ecosystems to maximize development productivity, optimize Field Service solutions, document custom implementations, and deliver secure, scalable, and high\-quality customer solutions.

**Minimum Requirements**
* 10\-15 years of experience leading Salesforce technical consulting projects and handling individual contributors, with a strong data focus.
* 5\+ years of people management experience.
* Strong application design skills combined with strong data, integration, and security architecture skills.
* Proficiency with data integration tools (Informatica, Talend, or similar)
* Solid understanding of SQL, PL/SQL, SOQL, Python, data loading tools, and Salesforce governor limits.
* Hands\-on experience with Salesforce Data Cloud (formerly CDP)
* Expertise in one or multiples of → Sales/Service/Experience Cloud, Salesforce Industries Cloud (Comms, H\&I or FSC OR RCA/RCB) with a foundational familiarity with Agentforce architectures being a plus.

title: Chief Track Expert- BID Position
description:
SYSTRA is one of the world's leading engineering and consulting groups specializing in public transport and mobility solutions. For over 65 years, the Group has been committed to helping cities and regions develop by creating, improving and modernizing their transport infrastructure and systems.
   

  

 Context
   

  

 In India, SYSTRA is an international consulting and engineering company operating in the fields of Metros, High Speed Rail, Railways, Roads, Buildings, Urban planning, and Water \& Environment for public and private organizations.
   

  

 Our engineers work with passion to deliver the most reliable, cost\-effective and made\-to measures solutions allowing end users to move seamlessly.
   

  

 SYSTRA’s unique expertise is backed with a reputation built through technical excellence delivered on projects. Thanks to our know\-how of our employees spread across India, we are present at all stages from upstream studies to operation and maintenance. We provide a comprehensive solution to manage all kinds of missions: Detailed Design Consultant, Project Management, Independent checking services.
   

  

 SYSTRA India’s comprehensive know\-how and expertise in Railways provides a wide spectrum of solutions for any challenge (Building a new rail link, doubling the capacity, gauge conversion, upgrading a network, improving the performance of existing lines, etc.).
   

  

 Our extensive experience encompasses, Bridges, station buildings, Depots, Earthwork \& Track Works, Power Supply and Transmission, Signaling \& Telecommunications, Rolling Stock, Utilities diversion and yard re\-modelling etc.
   

  

 Our services cover the entire life cycle of the project implementation.
   

  

 Currently, we are bidding for Semi High Speed Rail projects across India. The position of Chief Track Expert is the key position in these BIDs
   

  

 Missions/Main Duties
   

  

* Permanent Way Design and Specification: Lead the detailed design and engineering of the permanent way (track structure), including the selection of components like rails, sleepers, fastenings, and ballast/slab track systems, ensuring they meet the technical requirements for semi\-high speeds and high axle loads.
* Geometric Alignment and Survey Control: Finalize the horizontal and vertical track alignment (geometric design) based on approved feasibility studies. Establish and maintain the high\-precision survey control network to ensure the construction tolerances for high\-speed operation are strictly achieved.
* Track Construction and Quality Assurance (QA/QC): Oversee all phases of track construction, including formation, track laying, welding, and stressing. Implement and manage a rigorous Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) program to verify that all materials and construction methods comply with national and international railway codes.
* Integration of Special Trackwork: Direct the design and installation of special trackwork, such as switches, crossings (turnouts), and expansion joints, paying particular attention to their geometry and material specifications to ensure smooth and safe train movements at high speeds.
* Track Maintenance Strategy (LCC): Develop the long\-term track maintenance and renewal strategy (Life\-Cycle Cost or LCC) and specify the mechanized maintenance equipment needed. Establish the track monitoring and inspection protocols to ensure long\-term track safety and geometry standards.
* Coordination and Technical Compliance: Coordinate with other disciplines (Civil, Bridge, Signaling, OHE) to ensure seamless interface design. Ensure all track designs and construction practices strictly comply with the relevant Railway Permanent Way Manuals and safety regulations.


 Profile/Skills
   

  

* Qualification: Graduate in Engineering with working knowledge of reading, writing and speaking in English \[additional marks for PG in Engineering]
* Minimum Experience: 20 years post minimum qualification in any Rail based Passenger Transit system \[additional marks for more experience in any Rail based Passenger Transit system\*]
* Relevant Experience: 10 years’ experience for Design or Installation of Ballast\-less Track system including Track Alignment for MRTS /Regional Rail /High Speed Rail as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position \[additional marks for more experience; experience in position one level below allowed with less weightage]
* Eligible Assignment\*\*(see below): Must have experience of 1 Eligible Assignment as Chief Track Expert or equivalent position full\-time continuous deployment of not less than 2 years \[additional marks for more Eligible Assignments; less weightage for position one level below]
* Rail\-based Passenger Transit System shall mean
* High Speed Transit System / Regional Rail Transit System (with operational speed of 160kmh and above) OR
* Urban/Suburban/Intercity/Mass Rapid Transit System (MRTS) \[excluding LRT with design PHPDT less than 20000/Tram/Monorail Systems]
* Shall mean experience of working as a personnel of General Consultant / Project Management Consultant / Employer’s Personnel in a work / project in a Rail based Passenger Transit System with operational speed of 80 kmph or more comprising:
* Construction of Civil structures (at\-grade/elevated/underground) AND
* Installation of Systems (Track, Rolling Stock, Traction \& Power Supply, Signalling)


 Including Detailed Design or Proof checking of designs; Bid Process Management; Project and Interface Management; Construction Supervision and System Installations and Testing \& Commissioning
   

  

 We commit to put people who join us at the heart of improving transportation and urban infrastructure efficiency. As we are growing, this is time to be a part of this challenging adventure. It’s not a job \- it’s a career!

**Overview Of Role**

title: Manufacturing Excellence Analyst
description:
Job Characteristics
   

  

 This individual contributor role will focus on driving program deployment, adoption, governance, and scale\-up of a global Manufacturing Excellence Platform and Digital Manufacturing Cell. The role will enable best\-in\-class manufacturing operations through Digital \& AI, manufacturing KPI control tower capabilities, paperless shop\-floor execution, and scalable loss\-elimination solutions. The Program Deployment Analyst will partner with Manufacturing, TPM, HPN, Digital, AI, Engineering, Quality, Safety, Finance, and site leadership teams to convert the manufacturing digital vision into coordinated pilots, deployment waves, sustainment routines, and measurable business outcomes across Ecolab plants globally.
   

  

 Education / Work Experience
   

  

 Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Operations, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field of study. 8\+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing, supply chain, operational excellence, digital transformation, analytics, or technology\-enabled process improvement.
   

  

 Independence Level / Reports To
   

  

 Operates as an individual contributor with limited supervisory support from the leader and independently owns assigned deployment workstreams, analyses, deliverables, and stakeholder coordination. Interfaces directly with global and regional manufacturing leaders, plant managers, Digital \& AI teams, TPM / HPN partners, Finance, Quality, Safety, Engineering, technology development resources, and deployment teams. Normally reports to Manufacturing Excellence / Digital Manufacturing program leadership or Planning / Operations leadership, depending on final organization design. This role does not have direct people\-management responsibility.
   

  

**About Global Supply Chain**
 Our Global Supply Chain is a network of more than 100 manufacturing plants, distribution centers and other facilities designed and located to support our direct sales, marketing and distribution activities. We enable company growth by delivering savings through more efficient operations and high levels of service that create competitive advantage while earning and keeping customers' trust.
   

  

 Role Overview
   

  

 We are seeking a Program Deployment Analyst \- Manufacturing Excellence Platform / Digital Manufacturing Cell to drive deployment of the Manufacturing Cell program from pilot through global scale\-up as an individual contributor. The role will coordinate implementation of the manufacturing KPI control tower, paperless factory workstream, EKODE and related digital tools, and AI\-enabled loss\-elimination applications. The Program Deployment Analyst will independently manage stakeholder alignment, deployment wave planning, site readiness, training, adoption, risks, and benefits tracking for assigned workstreams to ensure the program delivers measurable improvements in productivity, compliance, data quality, and manufacturing loss reduction.
   

  

 What's in It for You
   

  

* Opportunity to drive deployment of a global manufacturing digital transformation agenda across Ecolab plants as a senior individual contributor.
* Exposure to manufacturing excellence, Digital \& AI, TPM / HPN, operations, engineering, quality, safety, finance, and site leadership stakeholders.
* Ability to scale solutions that reduce manual work, improve shop\-floor productivity, strengthen compliance, and accelerate loss elimination.


 What You Will Do
   

  

* Own and drive end\-to\-end deployment activities for the Manufacturing Excellence Platform across pilot sites, scale\-up waves, and sustainment phases for assigned workstreams.
* Coordinate implementation of the manufacturing KPI control tower, including replacement of legacy KPI tools, single\-point KPI entry, standard KPI definitions, and integrated data flows.
* Develop and manage deployment plans covering site readiness, stakeholder engagement, training, change management, cutover, issue resolution, and adoption tracking.
* Partner with plant managers and manufacturing teams to validate current pain points, Wave\-1 KPI priorities, data requirements, paperless opportunities, and practical deployment constraints.
* Drive paperless factory deployment by assessing site activities, mapping manual touchpoints, identifying quick wins, and converting paper\-based processes into digital, touchless, and audit\-ready workflows.
* Conduct and support digital maturity assessments across sites using common process mapping, maturity scoring, prioritization matrices, effort\-benefit analysis, and deployment sequencing.
* Coordinate deployment of automation and digital solutions including EKODE, eQMS, ERP, Power Automate, Copilot Agent, OCR\-based tools, barcode / QR code scanning, machine vision, and AI\-enabled loss\-elimination use cases.
* Work with technology development resources, data engineers, developers, AI teams, and business stakeholders to translate program requirements into deployable solutions and practical rollout plans.
* Establish and maintain governance cadence for assigned workstreams, including weekly working sessions, monthly progress reviews, quarterly program reviews, stakeholder feedback forums, and steering committee updates.
* Track deployment milestones, adoption metrics, risks, issues, dependencies, resource needs, and decision points across active workstreams.
* Partner with Finance and business teams to quantify and monetize KPI improvements, productivity gains, compliance risk reduction, and manufacturing loss\-elimination benefits.
* Prepare leadership\-ready status updates, deployment roadmaps, benefits trackers, risk / issue logs, action trackers, and decision materials for program reviews.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Manufacturing Operations, Business, Data Analytics, Information Systems, or related field of study.
* 5\+ years of applicable experience in manufacturing, supply chain, operational excellence, digital transformation, project / program delivery, analytics, or technology\-enabled process improvement in a manufacturing environment with global or multi\-site operations.
* Demonstrated experience independently driving deployments, pilots, scale\-up waves, change management, training, adoption, and sustainment of business or digital solutions.
* Advanced proficiency with ERP, reporting, workflow, collaboration, and productivity tools such as Excel, PowerPoint, Power BI, Power Automate, Planner, and related enterprise systems.
* Proven ability to conduct quantitative and qualitative analysis, synthesize inputs from multiple stakeholders, and make practical recommendations to Manufacturing and Supply Chain leadership.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management, teamwork, influencing, facilitation, and presentation skills, with the ability to deliver outcomes through cross\-functional collaboration without direct authority.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* Strong program delivery skills with a track record of independently delivering complex cross\-functional initiatives against schedule, quality, adoption, and business impact expectations.
* Experience with manufacturing excellence, TPM, HPN, Lean, Six Sigma, loss elimination, OEE / OPE / OLE, productivity, material loss, first\-pass quality, or related manufacturing KPIs.
* Experience deploying digital manufacturing tools, paperless workflows, automation, data visualization, AI use cases, or manufacturing control tower solutions.
* Familiarity with EKODE, eQMS, ERP, EBS, EPM, Power BI, workflow automation, OCR, barcode / QR code scanning, or machine vision technologies.
* PMP, Lean Six Sigma, APICS, or similar certification preferred.
* Advanced Degree preferred.


**Our Commitment to a Culture of Inclusion \& Belonging**
 Ecolab is committed to fair and equal treatment of associates and applicants and furthering the principles of Equal Opportunity to Employment. We will recruit, hire, promote, transfer and provide opportunities for advancement based on individual qualifications and job performance in all matters affecting employment, compensation, benefits, working conditions, and opportunities for advancement. Ecolab will not discriminate against any associate or applicant for employment because of race, religion, color, creed, national origin,citizenship status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and expressions, genetic information, marital status, age, or disability.

title: Independent Testing Manager - AI Execution
description:
**Job Description**
**About this role:**
 Wells Fargo is seeking an Independent Testing Manager
   

  

**In This Role, You Will**
* Manage a team of managers in cross\-functional teams in accomplishing goals and priorities
* Develop and design methodologies and standards for review activities across the Enterprise in alignment with the Risk Management Framework
* Ensure effective and appropriate testing, validation, and documentation of review activities for risk programs, risks, and controls according to standards and other applicable policies
* Develop, maintain, and execute the Annual Plan
* Assess, document, and communicate emerging risks, themes and identified issues to leadership and risk partners in a timely manner
* Ensure issues are identified and documented
* Identify potential corrective actions, and follows through on reporting, escalation, and resolution
* Perform moderate to high risk quality reviews
* Lead implementation of complex and strategic initiatives with moderate risk and complexity
* Ensure plan includes targeted reviews based on risk and meets internal past due benchmarks
* Lead moderate to high risk or complexity review activity engagements
* Escalate any critical or high risk issues to appropriate leadership
* Manage communication and collaboration with business heads, Legal, Audit, and regulators on risk related topics
* Provide status updates to key stakeholders on programs and specific reviews where warranted
* Manage allocation of people and financial resources for Independent Testing
* Mentor and guide talent development of direct reports and assist in hiring talent


**Required Qualifications:**
* 5\+ years of experience in Independent Testing experience, or equivalent demonstrated through one or a combination of the following: work experience, training, military experience, education
* 2\+ years of Leadership experience


**Desired Qualifications:**
* 10\-15\+ years of experience across risk, compliance, audit, assurance, or regulatory functions, with a strong emphasis on AI Strategy, Execution, and Optimization within large, regulated financial institutions.
* Demonstrated experience or strong foundational understanding of Generative AI principles, prompt engineering, and the common failure modes of LLMs (e.g., hallucinations, input token drift, constraints). Experience setting up performance testing protocols for automated or AI systems is preferred.
* Familiarity with managing API\-driven architectures, user workspace platforms, execution engines, or model benchmarking tools.
* Proven track record of drafting procedural documentation, scaling governance functions, and bringing operational clarity to ambiguous, fast\-moving technical environments. Ability to synthesize local data into high\-level global strategy inputs.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Information Systems, Risk Management, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).
* Proven experience in project and program delivery, including managing complex, high\-risk initiatives and regulatory\-driven timelines.
* Strategic, forward\-looking mindset with the ability to operate effectively in ambiguity.
* Strong project management and delivery experience.
* Demonstrated ability to work in complex, matrixed organizations and partner across diverse stakeholders.


**Job Expectations:**
 Wells Fargo is seeking an Independent Testing AI Manager to join the AI Execution (AIE) within Independent Testing \& Validation (IT\&V), Corporate Risk.
   

  

 This position is responsible for overseeing a proprietary prompt execution platform, collaborating closely with cross\-functional development teams, leading an advanced Quality Control (QC) validation process, and maintaining strict governance standards to minimize operational risk and provide process clarity. Furthermore, this leader will manage in\-house platform for cross\-functional prompt prototyping, manage AI performance testing, and actively contribute validation expertise to the company's global AI strategy.
   

  

 The ideal candidate blends technical understanding of Generative AI (GenAI) and API architectures with exceptional people leadership capabilities to cultivate a high\-performing validation organization.
   

  

* Lead and manage a team of AI Execution professionals to deliver Independent Testing objectives.
* Design and maintain AI\-enabled testing methodologies and standards aligned to the Risk Management Framework.
* Execute and oversee testing, validation, and documentation of risk programs, risks, and controls in accordance with enterprise standards and policies.
* Provide credible, independent challenge to lines of business across programs and risk themes.
* Perform and oversee quality reviews, including assessments of high\-risk work.
* Identify recurring issues, emerging risks, and common themes; ensure appropriate documentation, escalation, and tracking.
* Triage critical or high\-risk issues and determine appropriate next steps and escalation paths.
* Lead initiatives with enterprise\-wide or multi\-line\-of\-business impact.
* Manage resource allocation (people and financial) to ensure appropriate coverage during peak testing periods.
* Provide regular status updates to senior stakeholders and governance forums.
* Mentor, coach, and develop talent; support hiring and succession planning.
* Drive efficiencies, automation opportunities, and continuous improvement in analytics, metrics, and reporting.


**Proprietary AI Platform Management \& API Execution**
* Oversee the daily operations, maintenance, and long\-term scaling of the team's proprietary platform integrated via APIs to execute AI prompts.
* Ensure high platform availability, seamless API performance, and robust technical infrastructure capable of supporting enterprise\-level prompt execution.
* Coordinate with internal technical assets to prioritize platform updates, feature optimization, and technical performance enhancements.


**Stakeholder Collaboration \& Prompt Onboarding**
* Serve as the primary operational partner to the cross\-functional AI Prompt Development team and related business units.
* Define and manage the end\-to\-end workflow for onboarding newly created business process prompts onto the GenAI module of the platform.
* Facilitate clear communication channels to ensure business requirements, prompt behavior expectations, and engineering changes are perfectly aligned between development and testing.


**Quality Control (QC) \& AI Output Validation Framework**
* Directly lead and expand the AI Execution (AIE) QC team tasked with checking and validating prompt outputs.
* Establish comprehensive, objective validation methodologies to evaluate model outputs across diverse parameters, including hallucination detection, data input sufficiency, contextual accuracy, bias, and performance thresholds.
* Implement structured logging, performance dashboards, and actionable feedback loops to assist prompt developers in optimization.


**AI Performance Testing \& Benchmarking**
* Design and execute structured AI performance testing parameters to continuously measure, evaluate, and benchmark model responses.
* Track critical performance indicators including response latency, throughput under load, prompt execution speed, and token usage optimization.
* Partner with engineering teams to diagnose performance bottlenecks and maintain stable, scalable user experiences across all modules.


**AI Strategy**
* Deliver strategic testing data, performance benchmarks, and governance metrics to contribute meaningfully to the organization's overarching global AI strategy.
* Act as a subject matter expert to ensure localized validation procedures align seamlessly with global AI ethical guidelines, risk appetites, and technical deployment roadmaps.
* Identify emerging industry trends in AI validation to keep the enterprise at the cutting edge of safe AI adoption.


**Governance \& Procedure Management**
* Manage a dedicated Governance team focused on bringing clarity, standardization, and structural rigor to the team's operating environment.
* Author, implement, and maintain clear standard operating procedures (SOPs), validation criteria, and testing policy frameworks.
* Ensure the team's testing procedures align fully with enterprise risk controls, compliance guidelines, and evolving external AI regulatory frameworks.


**People Leadership \& Team Development**
* Recruit, mentor, and develop a diverse, high\-performing team composed of QC validation analysts, technical platform operators, and governance specialists.
* Foster a collaborative, growth\-oriented culture centered on accountability, continuous technical learning, and psychological safety.
* Set transparent performance goals, deliver regular constructive feedback, and map professional development pathways for team members.

 20 Sep 2026

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other legally protected characteristic.

description:
* Develop and implement long‑term and short‑term maintenance strategies to maximize machine uptime and availability.
* Prepare annual maintenance budgets (Capex \& Opex) and track adherence.
* Establish predictive, preventive, and shutdown maintenance plans.
* Evaluate and upgrade existing maintenance systems, tools, and processes.


 Founded in 1961, WEG is a global electric\-electronic equipment company, operating mainly in the capital goods sector with solutions in electric machines, automation and paints for several sectors, including infrastructure, steel, pulp and paper, oil and gas, mining, among many others.
   

  

 WEG stands out in innovation by constantly developing solutions to meet the major trends in energy efficiency, renewable energy and electric mobility. With manufacturing units in 17 countries and present in more than 135 countries, the company has more than 45,000 employees worldwide.
   

  

 WEG’s net revenue reached R$ 32\.5 billion in 2023, 52\.9% from outside Brazil.
   

  

 Our business areas are divided as follows.
   

  

**Industrial Electro\-Electronic Equipment**
 This area includes electric motors, drives and industrial automation equipment and services, and maintenance services. Electric motors and other related equipment find applications in practically all industrial segments, in equipment such as compressors, pumps and fans, for example.
   

  

**Energy Generation, Transmission and Distribution (GTD)**
 Products and services included in this area are electric generators for hydraulic and thermal power plants (biomass), hydro turbines (small hydroelectric plants or PCH, and hydroelectric generators or CGH)), wind turbines, transformers, substations, control panels and system integration services.
   

  

**Commercial and Appliance Motors**
 In this business area, our focus is the market of single phase motors for durable consumer goods, such as washing machines, air conditioners, water pumps, among others.
   

  

**Paints and Varnishes**
 In this area, which includes liquid paints, powder paints, and electro\-insulating varnishes, we have a very clear focus on industrial applications in Brazil and are expanding to Latin America and other regions.

title: Lead D&T Analyst – AI & Automation
description:
**Company Overview**
 We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
   

  

**Overview**
 The Digital and Technology (D\&T) India, is seeking a Lead Analyst, to join the AI and Automation team. The AIA Activation team serves as the bridge between identifying AI use cases to enabling value through business adoption. The AI \& Automation team is seeking a Lead AIA Analyst to shepherd General Mills’ AI journey into agent\-based (agentic) capabilities — planning, delivering, and governing our enterprise AI platforms, custom AI agents, and the processes that support them. This highly visible role will partner with business and D\&T stakeholders to identify and execute high‑value AI use cases, then create, manage, and sustain the expansion of generative and agent\-based capabilities across the enterprise, working closely with other D\&T AI initiatives to shape the overall AI user experience
   

  

**Key Accountabilities**
* Partner with functional domain stakeholders to identify, assess, and prioritize high\-value AI and agentic AI use cases.
* Lead discovery and opportunity assessment efforts to determine where AI can improve decision\-making, process efficiency, service levels, productivity, and user experience.
* Translate business problems into clear analytical, technical, and delivery requirements for AI solutions, agents, and supporting workflows.
* Lead planning and implementation of AI and automation initiatives, including pilots, proofs of value, and scaled deployments.
* Collaborate with business teams, product teams, data scientists, engineers, and platform partners to design and deliver Supply Chain AI capabilities.
* Support development of domain\-specific agents and workflows that augment functional domain processes and enable better human decision\-making.
* Evaluate existing functional domain processes, data, and pain points to determine where agentic AI can be responsibly and effectively applied.
* Facilitate workshops and working sessions with stakeholders to educate teams on AI possibilities, assess readiness, and define business value.
* Help establish and sustain governance processes for functional domain AI use cases, including risk management, user acceptance, monitoring, and continuous improvement.
* Ensure activation work follows established responsible AI, governance, risk, and documentation practices in partnership with the relevant teams.
* Contribute to development of best practices, playbooks, enablement assets, KPIs, and operating processes that strengthen activation capabilities across the Agentic AI office.
* Translate the learnings from the engagement to reusable consumable form for other areas to benefit from it.
* Support the intake, build, publish of the agents are in accordance to the defined frameworks by the AI Office.
* Monitor solution performance, user feedback, and business outcomes, then make recommendations for optimization and broader adoption.
* Analyze, present, and report on key performance indicators, value realization, and overall initiative progress to business and D\&T leaders.
* Partner to evaluate the technological releases including platform, services, models etc. within the Agentic AI space and document the recommendations.
* Work closely with the vendor partners as required to influence the prioritization of required features / fixes.
* Monitor feedback and insights, collaborating with Agent Authors to assess program effectiveness and make recommendations for optimization and improvement.
* Manage the agent publishing lifecycle, including user acceptance testing and acting as the first line of triage for agents.
* Monitor adoption, usage, performance, and user feedback for deployed capabilities, and help drive iterations that improve business impact and user experience over time.
* Foster a culture of experimentation, practical learning, collaboration, and continuous improvement within the team.


**Minimum Qualifications**
* Bachelor's in technology /engineering/science in a related field is required.
* Minimum years of related experience required: 2\+ years in AI, analytics, automation, digital product activation, data science, or related technical delivery roles, including experience leading projects or small teams.
* Overall industry experience: 10\+ years preferred Total analytics experience required 5\-6 Years.
* Experience activating AI, automation, analytics, or digital capabilities from pilot or proof of concept into business adoption.
* Demonstrated ability to partner with stakeholders to define business problems, translate needs into delivery plans, and drive measurable outcomes.
* Strong communication and storytelling skills with the ability to explain AI concepts, rollout implications, and recommendations to non\-technical audiences.
* Working knowledge of AI governance, responsible AI practices, documentation expectations, and production monitoring disciplines.
* Ability to operate effectively in an environment with global partners and cross\-functional D\&T teams.
* Technical Skillset \- AI / Automation Activation, Adoption \& Change Management, Use Case Framing / Business Translation, KPI Tracking / Value Realization.
* Responsible for AI, Security, Governance, Process Design, Workflow Mapping, Visualization / Storytelling, Agile Delivery / Backlog Management, Data Intuition, Analytics, Cloud Platform literacy.
* Strong understanding of AI and automation activation in at least one business or functional domain.
* Aware of adjacent DNA capabilities and knows when to engage experts from other domains.
* Creates stories and translates needs into executable work.
* Helps manage team backlog and delivery priorities.

 Senior Project Manager
   

  

**Job Description Summary**
 The Project Manager (Civil) is responsible for leading the planning, coordination, and execution of construction projects from inception to completion. The role involves managing the overall project delivery—including design coordination, budgeting, scheduling, quality, safety, and stakeholder communication—to ensure timely and cost\-effective completion of civil works and overall project scope.
   

  

**Job Description**
**About the Role:**
* Project Planning \& Execution
* Define project scope, objectives, and deliverables in alignment with client requirements.
* Prepare detailed project schedules, resource plans, and budgets.
* Establish project execution strategy and implement project management processes and controls.
* Drive overall project delivery in line with contractual terms, design intent, and company standards.
* Site Management \& Coordination
* Lead and supervise all civil and structural works, ensuring compliance with drawings, technical specifications, and quality standards.
* Coordinate with design consultants, contractors, and vendors for seamless project execution.
* Monitor site progress against schedule, identify delays or bottlenecks, and initiate corrective actions.
* Conduct regular project review meetings and ensure timely reporting to management and clients.

* Prepare project budgets, cost forecasts, and cash flow plans.
* Review and certify contractor bills, variations, and claims.
* Ensure adherence to cost control measures and approval protocols.
* Evaluate value engineering options for cost optimization.
* Quality, Safety \& Compliance

* Ensure strict adherence to HSE (Health, Safety \& Environment) policies and statutory norms.
* Conduct site audits, inspections, and safety toolbox meetings.
* Ensure timely closure of NCRs (Non\-Conformance Reports) and quality observations.

* Maintain accurate project records for billing, certification, and close\-out.

* Manage relationships with consultants, contractors, vendors, and internal teams.

Time zone overlap with the US team is limited, so you will work mostly from recordings and written context rather than live calls \- and you will be trusted to keep the plan moving without needing to be on every call.
   

  

 This is a hands\-on role \- we need someone who catches issues early, keeps every workstream up to date, and makes sure open action items get closed.
   

  

 What You Will Own
   

  

**Responsibilities**

* Track budget vs. actual hours by workstream and flag variances


**Call Follow\-Up and Action Items**
* Review call transcripts and recordings, extract action items, owners, and deadlines

* Draft follow\-up emails and status recaps from template


**Deliverable and Deck Support**
* Build and update integration status slides for client and internal steering committee updates

**Program Management Support**

 What Great Looks Like:
   

  

* Turns transcripts and notes into accurate deliverables, no live call context needed
* Keeps trackers and decks current across every active deal \- no stale data
* Flags variances, blockers, and stale action items before they become problems
* Learns the playbook well enough to run it cleanly across multiple deals at once

* Comfort working from meeting transcripts and written notes rather than live call attendance
* Strong PowerPoint skills
* Comfort building and maintaining trackers, dashboards, and structured data views
* Excellent written English \- you'll be drafting emails and updates that go straight to clients
* Strong attention to detail and a low tolerance for stale or broken data
* Comfortable working independently on recurring tasks without much oversight
* Some overlap with US Eastern or Central time is preferred but not required
* Bonus: background in M\&A, IT integration, or program management


 Tools You Will Use
   

  

 Notion, SharePoint, Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel), call transcript tools (Fireflies or similar), AI (Copilot, Claude, etc.) and internal communication tools. You do not need to be an expert in all of these on day one, but you should be able to come up to speed quickly.

**Job Summary**

 **secure development lifecycle** 
 (SDL) requirements and ensuring compliance through coordinated
 **security reviews and assessments** 
 . Serves as the primary security point of contact for product teams while collecting evidence required for compliance.

**Key Responsibilities**
* Execute SDL requirements across the full product development lifecycle.

* Experience with vulnerability management and risk assessment.
* Excellent communication skills for technical and business stakeholders.
* Project management experience with cross\-functional teams.
* Ability to drive improvements in security culture.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and provide guidance to technical colleagues.
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field, or equivalent professional experience.


**Preferred Qualifications**
* CSSLP or similar secure development certification
* Familiarity with cloud security best practices (preferably Azure)
* Experience with enterprise software security frameworks (SOC 2, ISO 27001\)
* Experience with product or cloud security architecture
* Background in SaaS or enterprise software environments


**Reports To:** 
 Product Security Lead
   

  

 We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, as well as opportunities for professional growth and development. If you are a motivated self\-starter with a passion for application security, we encourage you to apply for this exciting opportunity.

* Ability to independently apply tools, principles, concepts, and techniques related to requirements, data, usability, and process analysis
